name: Llama 3.1 8B
blurb: Well-rounded general-purpose model with a long context window.
profile: A well-rounded 8B general-purpose assistant with a very long 128K context window. Best for everyday chat, instruction following, summarizing long documents, drafting and rewriting text, answering questions, and serving as a dependable default model for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over your own files and notes. A safe first choice when you are unsure which model to pick.

name: Llama 3.2 3B
blurb: Compact and fast — a good default on memory-constrained machines.
profile: A compact, fast 3B model that runs comfortably on laptops with limited memory. Best for on-device assistants, quick drafting, text classification, short summaries, simple question answering, and low-latency tasks where speed and a small footprint matter more than maximum quality.

name: Llama 3.2 1B
blurb: Tiny model for edge and ultra-low-latency use.
profile: A tiny 1B model built for edge devices and ultra-low-latency workloads. Best for fast autocomplete, simple text transformations, intent routing and classification, keyword extraction, and embedded uses where memory and battery are scarce. Not suited to complex reasoning.

name: Llama 3.3 70B
blurb: Frontier-class open model rivaling much larger systems.
profile: A frontier-class 70B model offering near state-of-the-art quality among open models. Best for complex reasoning, nuanced instruction following, long-form writing and synthesis, sophisticated agent workflows, and demanding analytical tasks. Requires a high-memory machine but delivers the strongest general results in this catalog.

name: Qwen 2.5 7B
blurb: Strong, efficient all-rounder with excellent multilingual support.
profile: A strong and efficient 7B all-rounder with excellent multilingual ability and reliable structured (JSON) output. Best for general assistance, translation and multilingual chat, data extraction, generating structured responses for downstream tools, and everyday reasoning on modest hardware.

name: Qwen 2.5 14B
blurb: Strong multilingual and reasoning performance for its size.
profile: A capable 14B model with strong reasoning and multilingual performance for its size. Best for analytical question answering, multilingual tasks, tool-using agents, structured data extraction, and mid-complexity work that benefits from more depth than a 7B model while staying runnable on a 16GB machine.

name: Qwen 2.5 32B
blurb: High-quality reasoning approaching larger frontier models.
profile: A high-quality 32B model whose reasoning approaches much larger systems. Best for complex analysis, multi-step reasoning, demanding agent workflows, careful instruction following, and professional writing, when you have the memory to run a larger model but cannot fit a 70B.

name: Qwen 2.5 Coder 7B
blurb: Code-specialized model tuned for completion and review.
profile: A code-specialized 7B model tuned for software development. Best for writing and completing code, reviewing pull requests, refactoring, debugging, explaining unfamiliar code, generating tests, and acting as a local coding assistant or pair programmer across many programming languages.

name: Qwen 2.5 Coder 32B
blurb: Top-tier open coding model for serious development work.
profile: A top-tier open coding model at 32B, among the best available for local software development. Best for generating substantial code, designing and reasoning about software architecture, complex debugging, large refactors, code review, and acting as a capable autonomous coding agent when you have the memory to run it.

name: Mistral 7B
blurb: Fast, capable workhorse that punches above its weight.
profile: A fast, efficient 7B workhorse that punches above its weight. Best for general chat, information extraction, summarization, tool and function calling, and as a low-latency backbone for applications and agents on everyday hardware.

name: Mistral Nemo 12B
blurb: 12B model with a long context and strong tool use.
profile: A 12B model with a long 128K context and strong function-calling ability, built with NVIDIA. Best for long-document processing, multilingual tasks, tool-using agents, and applications that need to reason over large inputs while remaining efficient to run.

name: Mixtral 8x7B
blurb: Sparse mixture-of-experts; high quality but memory-hungry.
profile: A sparse mixture-of-experts model with 8x7B experts, delivering high quality at strong inference speed but with a large memory footprint. Best for demanding reasoning, long-form generation, synthesis across sources, and high-throughput serving when ample RAM is available.

name: Phi 3.5 Mini
blurb: Small model with surprisingly strong reasoning for its footprint.
profile: A small 3.8B model with surprisingly strong reasoning and a long context for its footprint. Best for on-device reasoning, math and logic on constrained hardware, summarization, and edge deployments where you want capable thinking without a large model.

name: Phi 4 14B
blurb: Reasoning-focused 14B that excels at math and logic.
profile: A reasoning-focused 14B model that excels at mathematics, logic, and STEM problem solving relative to its size. Best for step-by-step quantitative reasoning, technical question answering, coding logic, and analytical tasks where careful thinking matters more than world knowledge.

name: Gemma 2 2B
blurb: Tiny, efficient open model from Google's Gemini lineage.
profile: A tiny, efficient 2B open model from Google's Gemini research lineage. Best for on-device chat, quick drafting, classification, and lightweight assistant features where a very small, responsive model is preferred.

name: Gemma 2 9B
blurb: Balanced open model from the Gemini research lineage.
profile: A balanced 9B open model from Google's Gemini lineage. Best for general chat, polished writing and editing, question answering, and summarization, offering a good quality-to-size tradeoff on mainstream hardware.

name: Gemma 2 27B
blurb: Larger Gemma for higher-quality writing and reasoning.
profile: A larger 27B Gemma model for higher-quality writing and reasoning. Best for professional and creative writing, careful analysis, nuanced question answering, and editing, when you want strong quality from an open Google model and have the memory to run it.

name: DeepSeek R1 7B
blurb: Reasoning-focused distill that shows its chain of thought.
profile: A reasoning-focused 7B distillation that thinks step by step and shows its chain of thought. Best for math, logic puzzles, planning, structured problem solving, and tasks where transparent multi-step reasoning is valued over speed.

name: DeepSeek R1 14B
blurb: Stronger reasoning distill for harder problems.
profile: A 14B reasoning distillation with stronger problem-solving than the 7B. Best for harder math and logic, careful analysis, multi-step planning, and technical reasoning where you want explicit chain-of-thought and can spare more memory.

name: DeepSeek R1 32B
blurb: High-end reasoning distill approaching frontier problem-solving.
profile: A high-end 32B reasoning distillation approaching frontier problem-solving. Best for the most demanding math, logic, and research-style reasoning tasks among local models, with explicit step-by-step thinking, when you have substantial memory available.

name: DeepSeek Coder V2 16B
blurb: Mixture-of-experts coder with broad language coverage.
profile: A mixture-of-experts coding model (16B) with broad programming-language coverage and a long context. Best for code generation and completion, debugging, repository-scale understanding, and as a fast local coding assistant for many languages.

name: Code Llama 13B
blurb: Llama-based code model for generation and infilling.
profile: A Llama-based 13B code model specialized for programming. Best for code generation, fill-in-the-middle completion, writing functions from descriptions, and general coding assistance, especially in editor and IDE integration scenarios.

name: CodeGemma 7B
blurb: Google's code model for completion and generation.
profile: Google's 7B code model built on Gemma. Best for code completion and fill-in-the-middle, generating short functions and snippets, and lightweight coding assistance integrated into editors.

name: StarCoder2 7B
blurb: Open code model trained on a broad permissive corpus.
profile: An open 7B code model from BigCode trained across hundreds of programming languages on a permissively licensed corpus. Best for code completion, fill-in-the-middle, and multi-language programming assistance where licensing transparency matters.

name: LLaVA 7B
blurb: Multimodal model that understands images and text.
profile: A multimodal 7B vision-language model that accepts images alongside text. Best for describing and captioning images, answering questions about pictures, reading charts and screenshots, and visual question answering on everyday hardware.

name: LLaVA 13B
blurb: Larger multimodal model for richer image understanding.
profile: A larger 13B vision-language model for richer image understanding. Best for detailed image description, analyzing document images and screenshots, visual reasoning, and visual question answering when you want higher quality than the 7B variant.

name: Llama 3.2 Vision 11B
blurb: Meta's multimodal model for image reasoning and OCR-like tasks.
profile: Meta's 11B multimodal model that reasons over images and text with a long context. Best for understanding documents and screenshots, interpreting charts and diagrams, image-grounded question answering, and tasks that combine visual input with longer instructions.

name: Command R 35B
blurb: Built for retrieval-augmented generation and tool use.
profile: A 35B model purpose-built for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and tool use, with strong grounding and citation behavior over long contexts. Best for building a local knowledge base or document Q&A over your files, answering with citations, multi-step tool-using agents, and enterprise-style retrieval workflows.

name: Command R+ 104B
blurb: Cohere's flagship for advanced RAG and agentic tool use.
profile: Cohere's flagship 104B model for advanced retrieval-augmented generation and agentic tool use. Best for high-accuracy knowledge bases and document Q&A with citations, complex multi-step tool-using agents, and demanding enterprise retrieval tasks, when you have the substantial memory required.

name: Nomic Embed Text
blurb: High-quality text embeddings for local semantic search.
profile: A high-quality text embedding model, not a chat model. Best for turning text into vectors to power semantic search, building the retrieval half of a RAG pipeline or local knowledge base, clustering and deduplication, and similarity matching over documents. Use it to index your files, not to generate answers.

name: mxbai Embed Large
blurb: State-of-the-art open embedding model for retrieval.
profile: A state-of-the-art open text embedding model, not a chat model. Best for high-accuracy semantic search and retrieval, indexing documents for a RAG pipeline or knowledge base, and similarity and clustering tasks where embedding quality is the priority. Pairs with a chat model to answer questions.

name: all-MiniLM 22M
blurb: Tiny, fast embedding model for lightweight search.
profile: A tiny, very fast text embedding model, not a chat model. Best for lightweight semantic search, on-device similarity matching, quick clustering, and resource-constrained retrieval where speed and small size outweigh maximum embedding accuracy.

name: TinyLlama 1.1B
blurb: Very small chat model for experimentation and edge use.
profile: A very small 1.1B chat model. Best for experimentation, learning, ultra-low-resource and edge deployments, simple drafting, and prototyping where footprint and speed matter far more than answer quality.

name: SmolLM2 1.7B
blurb: Small but capable model tuned for instruction following.
profile: A small 1.7B model from Hugging Face tuned for instruction following and surprisingly capable for its size. Best for on-device assistants, drafting and rewriting, short summarization, and lightweight tasks on laptops and constrained devices.

name: Granite 3 Dense 8B
blurb: IBM's enterprise model tuned for tools and RAG.
profile: IBM's 8B enterprise-oriented model tuned for tool use, retrieval-augmented generation, and business workflows. Best for function and tool calling, document Q&A and knowledge bases, summarization of business content, and agentic workflows in professional settings with a permissive license.

name: Dolphin Mixtral 8x7B
blurb: Uncensored, instruction-tuned mixture-of-experts.
profile: An uncensored, instruction-tuned fine-tune of Mixtral's mixture-of-experts. Best for open-ended and creative chat, roleplay and storytelling, brainstorming without heavy refusals, and tasks where a more compliant, less filtered assistant is wanted. Memory-hungry like the base Mixtral.

name: Neural Chat 7B
blurb: Intel's fine-tuned conversational model.
profile: Intel's 7B conversational fine-tune based on Mistral. Best for friendly general-purpose chat, question answering, drafting, and everyday assistant tasks on mainstream hardware.

name: WizardLM 2 7B
blurb: Instruction-tuned model strong at complex prompts.
profile: A 7B instruction-tuned model that handles complex, multi-part prompts well. Best for following detailed instructions, structured writing, reasoning over involved requests, and assistant tasks that require careful adherence to nuanced directions.
